scope: Independent PortraitLab V2 lighting and geometry modules; installed software is unchanged.

validation.reason: The coordinator confirmed all features were implemented and started unified validation before these tests ran.
validation.functional_scope: Synthetic-field native-tile identity, float preservation, light control response, coordinate mapping, failure contracts, geometry-support culling and exact zero-coverage lighting culling against the original calculation; no real model or real-photo quality claim.
evidence_limits: The current real-photo evidence contains one independent original.
No matched Zhijing result is available for that original.
4070 Ti 12 GB performance and compatibility have not been verified.
Implementation status does not establish professional retouching quality or superiority to another product.

features: Independent subject and background groups with complementary masks
Up to four directional, point, spot or area lights per group
Light position, direction, intensity, colour temperature, radius and softness
Spotlight beam angle and target position
Canvas-handle position helpers, including directional angle updates
Group ambient gain and overall adjustment strength
Native-resolution region rendering and float linear-RGB composition
Explicit local depth-model preparation with model hash verification

model.name: Depth Anything V2 Small
model.purpose: Relative depth; surface normals are derived from depth rather than inferred by a separate normal model.
model.license: Apache-2.0 for the pinned code and Small weights only

subject_mask.input: Genuine background probabilities from the existing person-part segmentation model
subject_mask.fallback: No substitution of a face mask or synthetic segmentation

coordinate_contract.handles: Normalized image coordinates with aspect-aware directional projection
coordinate_contract.light_radius: Point/spot attenuation reach or area-emitter size; directional radius does not affect shading

limitations: This is a deterministic image adjustment, not generative image synthesis or physical inverse rendering.
Single-view relative depth and its derived normals cannot recover true material reflectance or complete scene geometry.
Existing illumination and baked-in shadows remain; clipped source detail cannot be reconstructed.
True cast shadows, occlusion and physically accurate rim or Rembrandt shadows are not generated.
Mask and estimated-geometry errors can affect hair, fine edges and unusual scenes.
CPU rendering and CUDA depth preparation are distinct operations; immediate interactive latency is not yet measured.
Preset appearance and strength require the unified visual review.

features: Left/right face width, cheek and jaw controls
Manual push and local restore strokes
Local protection circles and image-edge taper
Compact-support inverse sampling with one interpolation stage
Native-size tiled reading, preserving float source values

dependencies.face_controls: Existing real face-landmark arrays; missing required landmarks raise an error

coordinate_contract.brush_radius: Fraction of the shorter image edge
coordinate_contract.manual_strokes: Displayed-image coordinates at gesture time; do not forward-project the stroke centre again
coordinate_contract.face_anchors: Original normalized landmarks projected through preceding face operations
coordinate_contract.parameter_direction: Positive widens or lengthens; positive forehead height moves upward

bounds_and_feedback.single_push: Displacement limited to 20 percent of the support radius
bounds_and_feedback.clamp_feedback: build_operations metadata contains stroke_clamps and warnings
bounds_and_feedback.protection_core: Inner 60 percent exactly protected; outer 40 percent smoothly blended
bounds_and_feedback.state_owner: The workspace owns history, drafts, atomic commits and user-visible feedback

limitations: This is local 2D deformation, not 3D anatomical reconstruction or identity-aware synthesis.
Hair and background inside the support region may move with the face.
Strong accumulated edits can look unnatural and require visual review.
Overlay forward mapping can reject excessive deformation if inversion fails to converge.
Tile/export consistency is an implementation contract pending unified validation.
